subject: english
stem: Which answer is supported by the passage that includes “Every Saturday morning, volunteers cook soup at the community center.”?
options: Anyone can put food inside, and anyone who needs food can take it.
One Saturday, their mother said she would not remind anyone anymore.
Anyone could write a short message to thank someone at school.
The soup is given to anyone who needs a warm meal.

optionRationales.reason: 本文沒有陳述「Anyone can put food inside, and anyone who needs food can take it.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「One Saturday, their mother said she would not remind anyone anymore.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「Anyone could write a short message to thank someone at school.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文可直接核對「The soup is given to anyone who needs a warm meal.」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。
